metadata.description: Personal Claude Code plugins for coding guidelines, GitHub Actions conventions, security review, and spec-driven development.

plugins.name: sorah-guides
plugins.description: Coding guidelines and review tools. Skills for general coding, Ruby, Rails (including problem-details errors, protobuf-native APIs, psqldef schemas, and Aurora DSQL), Sorbet typing and adoption, Rust, Terraform, GitHub Actions workflows, security, git commit style, README writing, and Japanese and English text writing. Includes a security review agent.

plugins.name: sorah-spec
plugins.description: Reviews spec files and conducts exhaustive interview sessions to resolve ambiguities, gaps, and missing details until specs are implementation-ready.
